title: Dangerous and Doesn't Broil Properly.
text:
Dangerous and Doesn't Broil Properly.. Sorry I wasted my money. I love the size, but mine doesn't broil properly and worse, the steel trim on the doors gets so hot that I got a second-degree burn the first time I used it. Would it have been so hard to use the same material for the trim that is used on the handles, which stay cool enough to touch? What makes this more dangerous is that you have to open the doors all the way to get them to stay open. If you are turning something in the oven and accidentally graze a doors, which will cause them both to slam shut, the trim will come squarely up against your arm - prepare for a relatively serious burn.

I am so disappointed. I could almost live with the danger of getting burnt, but the fact that still I have to use my full-size oven broiler to broil anything I want crispy on the top, negates part of the reason I like counter-top ovens. I wish I had used it before the 30 days were up. Now I will have to sell it on CL.

product_metadata.title: Oster TSSTTVFDXL Manual French Door Oven, Stainless Steel
features: Single door pull opens both doors with one hand ease and convenience
Turbo Convection baking technology cooks faster and browns more evenly
60 minute timer with signal turns oven off automatically
Extra large interior accommodates two pizzas
Two racks provide maximum cooking flexibility
description: Voila, dinner's done! The Oster French Door Oven looks elegant, cooks with convection and makes meal prep easier. Unique design opens both doors open with a single pull so you can place dishes in the oven without hassle. Adjustable temperature and cook controls provide ease and convenience to bake, toast, broil, warm and convection cook with simple adjustments. Plus, broiling setting adjusts to broil at any temperature to reduce overcooking or undercooking. There's no reason to turn up the heat with your conventional oven, as the Oster French Door Oven cooks more efficiently, using up to 50% less energy, plus its extra large interior provides plenty of space to prepare full meals. Set the 60-minute timer to cook foods as long as you need, then the oven shuts off automatically. With a countertop oven this attractive, this efficient and this easy to use, you'll enjoying using it for every meal you prepare!.
